$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/qa/state-coverage.ts. ignore: not a state a route must reach (key = <Board>, <Board>.<prop> or <Board>.<value>). demoOnly: the state is proven on a demo route (/dev/ui/...) and the reason says why real data is not needed or not possible yet. deferred: the board is in this phase but the state ships later ({phase, reason}); it is not counted while docs/qa/phase.txt < phase and is due from that phase on. Persona S 'banner' and the real 401/429 paths are @state (phase-01 plan §12.3); V3Nav play/learn/profile, the palette and the shortcuts dialog are also reached on real routes by e2e/specs/shell.spec.ts; everything else in P1 is @demo with a reason here.

ignore.V3FlowMap: Reference board: the route map and navigation graph. It has no route (allocation.md row 284).
ignore.V3GamePrototype: Interaction prototype of the board (one state). Its contract is the board input spec: e2e/devices/ui/board.spec.ts on /dev/ui/board (WP-F).

demoOnly.V3Nav.play: Also real (shell.spec.ts #1); /dev/ui/shell?current=play holds it for the device projects and the dark-theme check.
demoOnly.V3Nav.learn: Also real (shell.spec.ts #3 on /legends); /dev/ui/shell?current=legends holds it for the device projects.
demoOnly.V3Nav.profile: Also real (shell.spec.ts #4 on the legacy /profile inside the shell); Profile v3 is built in P10.
demoOnly.V3CommandPalette.open: The palette is a shell overlay; its content does not depend on account data (shell.spec.ts covers it on /play too).
demoOnly.V3CommandPalette.closed: Closed is the shell's resting state; no data involved.

demoOnly.V3Game.loading: The first frame before the join ack; with real data it lasts well under a second and cannot be held without stubbing the socket (every game spec passes through it). The demo holds it for layout.
demoOnly.V3Game.study_last5: The last 5 s of the 30 s study ring; real specs end study early with both "I’m ready" (friend-full, rematch-swap), so the last-five styling is checked on the demo.
demoOnly.V3Game.study_reconnect: A socket drop during study; the reconnect path itself is real in reconnect-queued-move.spec.ts (playing phase) and restart-resume.spec.ts; the study variant is copy only.
demoOnly.V3Game.rematch_first: First-move window of a rematch from the initial position; rematch-swap.spec.ts reaches the rematch with real data on a legend (rematch_study); the first-move variants differ only in copy.
demoOnly.V3Game.rematch_your: As rematch_first, for the side to move.
demoOnly.V3Game.rejected: A move the server refuses although the client thought it legal (a desync); the negative-ack rollback is real in optimistic-offers.spec.ts (forced draw_cooldown ack); the move variant is shown on the demo.
demoOnly.V3Game.opp_reconnected: The short toast after the opponent’s socket returns; opponent-offline.spec.ts covers the disconnect with real data, the 3 s reconnect toast is checked on the demo.
demoOnly.V3Game.server_error: Needs repeated sync failures from the server (SYNC_FAILURES_FOR_ERROR); only the demo can force it.
demoOnly.V3Game.over_insufficient: Automatic end by a capture into a bare-king ending: the rule is unit-tested (game-core end.test.ts, chess-fixtures) and the automatic-end path is real in threefold/stalemate-fifty; the card is shown on the demo.

demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.loading: The first frame before the join ack; with real data it lasts well under a second and cannot be held without stubbing the socket (every game spec passes through it). The demo holds it for layout.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.study_last5: The last 5 s of the 30 s study ring; real specs end study early with both "I’m ready" (friend-full, rematch-swap), so the last-five styling is checked on the demo.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.study_reconnect: A socket drop during study; the reconnect path itself is real in reconnect-queued-move.spec.ts (playing phase) and restart-resume.spec.ts; the study variant is copy only.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.rematch_first: First-move window of a rematch from the initial position; rematch-swap.spec.ts reaches the rematch with real data on a legend (rematch_study); the first-move variants differ only in copy.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.rematch_your: As rematch_first, for the side to move.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.rejected: A move the server refuses although the client thought it legal (a desync); the negative-ack rollback is real in optimistic-offers.spec.ts (forced draw_cooldown ack); the move variant is shown on the demo.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.opp_reconnected: The short toast after the opponent’s socket returns; opponent-offline.spec.ts covers the disconnect with real data, the 3 s reconnect toast is checked on the demo.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.server_error: Needs repeated sync failures from the server (SYNC_FAILURES_FOR_ERROR); only the demo can force it.
demoOnly.V3RematchOffer.over_insufficient: Automatic end by a capture into a bare-king ending: the rule is unit-tested (game-core end.test.ts, chess-fixtures) and the automatic-end path is real in threefold/stalemate-fifty; the card is shown on the demo.
